verdict.rationale: Pylon's Assist Agent is documented as an interactive AI teammate that drafts replies for the human team. That is a copilot-style pattern where a human sits between the draft and the customer. However, nothing documents a supervised launch mode or approval gate for the customer-facing Support Agent; issue assignment (scope control) and simulation testing are related but different controls. Missing for 10: an explicit draft-for-approval mode for the Support Agent, documented approve/edit/send workflow guaranteeing nothing reaches customers unreviewed, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support ops lead, I can launch in a supervised mode where the agent drafts replies for human approval before anything reaches a customer

citations.quote: Assist Agent is an interactive AI teammate that helps your team investigate questions, draft replies, and take action with the context already available in Pylon.
